transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I'm here because I have an intense, overwhelming fear of dogs. I get absolutely terrified whenever I am near one, and I really need some help managing it.
Do you avoid places or activities because you might encounter a dog, and has this fear been interfering with your daily life?

Yes, I completely avoid going to local parks, walking on certain streets, and even visiting friends who have dogs. This has really disrupted my daily routine and severely limited my social life, making it hard to just live normally.
How long have you had this fear of dogs, and has it been present for at least 6 months?
Yes, I've had this intense fear of dogs for about eight months now. So it has definitely been going on for longer than six months.
When you see a dog or think you might encounter one, do you immediately feel intense fear or panic, such as a racing heart, shaking, or shortness of breath?

Yes, absolutely. Just the thought of running into a dog makes me incredibly anxious, and if I actually see one, I immediately panic. My heart starts racing, I shake all over, and it feels like I can't catch my breath.
Do you feel that your fear of dogs is stronger than the actual danger they usually pose, even though it still feels uncontrollable?

Yes, intellectually I know most dogs are harmless and my fear is way out of proportion to any actual danger. But in the moment, all logic goes out the window, and the terror feels completely overwhelming and uncontrollable.
